ctgov.note: Only legacy dermaPACE diabetic-foot-ulcer pivotal studies returned; both COMPLETED (NCT00536744) or UNKNOWN/last updated 2014 (NCT01824407)

commercial_product.name: UltraMIST System
commercial_product.description: Non-contact, low-frequency, non-thermal ultrasound delivered via fluid (saline) mist for wound healing and debridement. Sold under razor/razor-blade model: capital generator + single-use sterile applicators (cases of 12).
approved_indications: Wound healing and debridement of acute and chronic wounds, including diabetic foot ulcers, venous leg ulcers, split-thickness wounds/skin grafts, deep tissue pressure injuries, and surgical wounds
commercial_product.regulatory_status: FDA 510(k) cleared (K140782); CMS Category 1 reimbursement under code 97610; ISO 13485:2016 certified

excluded_legacy_terminated: NCT00536744 — dermaPACE diabetic foot ulcer Phase 3 (COMPLETED 2010)
NCT01824407 — dermaPACE diabetic foot ulcer Phase 3 comparison (UNKNOWN status; last updated 2014; sponsor no longer markets dermaPACE per 2025 10-K)
no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Single-product commercial medtech: UltraMIST is FDA-cleared and the only marketed product (~99% of FY2025 revenue). Per the FY2025 10-K, the company discloses no active interventional clinical trials of its own devices. Legacy dermaPACE pivotal studies (NCT00536744, NCT01824407) are completed/dormant and dermaPACE is no longer the company's commercial focus. R&D headcount of 15 (of 55 total) is directed at product development, regulatory, quality and clinical support rather than active pivotal studies.
